info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Package engine is Hanzo Engine: which models the serving runtime has loaded, and the GPUs under it.

get.summary: Read one model's load state on the serving runtime
get.description:
Model reads one model's load state — loaded, unloading, or not_found, as
the engine itself reports it.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model is the model id to inspect, exactly as the model list reports it.

get.summary: List the models the serving runtime holds, with each one's load state
get.description:
Models lists the models the engine serves, each with its load state — the
server's own model table (its standard list envelope, load status
included), relayed verbatim.

get.summary: Whether the serving runtime is reachable, and which build it runs
get.description:
Status reports whether the engine deployment is reachable and which build
revision it runs — an honest lens for "is the serving runtime up", never a
fabricated ok.

get.summary: The serving host's own inventory: devices, memory and build capabilities
get.description:
System reads the engine host's inventory: OS, CPU, memory, every accelerator
device with its VRAM and compute capability, and the build's capabilities
(CUDA/Metal/flash-attention) — the real hardware under the serving runtime,
relayed verbatim.

reachable.description: Reachable is true when the engine answered its health probe.

revision.description:
Revision is the engine build's git revision, present only when
reachable (the server's own build identity — it publishes no semver).

bearer.description: The caller's credential, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It is either an access token minted by Hanzo IAM or an API key (pk-/sk-). X-Authorization, and HTTP Basic carrying the token as the password, are accepted spellings of the same header for clients that cannot set Authorization; a browser presents the session cookie instead. Every operation requires it unless it says `security: []`.
